This role requires technical proficiency in Crystal Reports for core transactional documents alongside advanced analytics tools like Sage Enterprise Intelligence (SEI) and Power BI, grounded in strong database and SQL skills within Sage X3 or related enterprise ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics).     Key Responsibilities   1. Operational & Document Reporting (Crystal Reports & Native Tools)   Crystal Reports Development: Design, modify, and optimize complex operational reports and business-critical print documents (e.g., Invoices, Purchase Orders, Order Confirmations, Packing Slips, and Financial Statements) using Crystal Reports.   Build and maintain custom formulas, parameters, conditional formatting, cross-tabs, and subreports within Crystal Reports to handle complex ERP logic.   Troubleshoot report execution speed, formatting bugs, missing data parameters, and printer driver compatibility within the ERP environment.   Maintain native ERP inquiry screens, data entry windows, and standard report catalogues.   2. Intelligence Reporting & Business Intelligence (BI)   Develop and maintain enterprise-wide analytical dashboards and management scorecards using Sage Enterprise Intelligence (SEI), Microsoft Power BI, SSRS, and Oracle OTBI / BI Publisher.   Create semantic data models, star schemas, and automated data pipelines to extract ERP transactional data into analytical datasets.   Collaborate with client and users in Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and HR to translate reporting requests into actionable KPIs.   3. Database & Query Optimization   Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, indexing strategies, and database views specifically optimized as data sources for Crystal Reports and BI models.   Create and develop middleware utilizing COM APIs, .NET SDKs, and REST/SOAPWeb Services.    Required Qualifications & Technical Skills   Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.   ERP Experience: Minimum 3 years of technical consulting or hands-on development experience in Sage X3 (strongly preferred) or other enterprise ERPs, including SAP S/4HANA/ECC, Oracle Cloud ERP/NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics 365.   - Reporting Tools Mastery:   Crystal Reports with proven expertise in complex formulas, subreports, parameters, data sources, and report layout design.   Sage Enterprise Intelligence (SEI), Microsoft Power BI (DAX/Power Query), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Oracle BI Publisher, or OTBI.   Strong ability to develop custom reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions based on business requirements.   - Programming Languages & Development Skills:   Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or PHP.   Experience with Sage X3 development technologies, including 4GL, Syracuse platform, scripting, custom objects, and development tools is an added advantage.
